first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and shortening onboarding previously improved completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. A guarded test is more aligned with sustainable revenue than promotional pricing, which previously harmed 30-day retention. Verify activation-messaging evidence as a secondary option, while measuring qualified downstream activation rather than completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a controlled onboarding simplification experiment, targeting the current 4% completion decline and leveraging confirmed gains in completion, time-to-value, adoption, and 30-day retention. Measure qualified activation and downstream revenue, not completion alone, with retention guardrails. Activation messaging is also validated, but onboarding is the more direct response to the current funnel deterioration and offers stronger retention evidence than promotional pricing.
